احتضنتا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَضَنَتَا (iḥtaḍanatā) /iħ.ta.dˤa.na.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# اُحْتُضِنَتَا (uḥtuḍinatā) /uħ.tu.dˤi.na.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
